text: 【港交所：陆续推出更多人民币计价贵金属等商品投资产品】港交所董事总经理兼市场主管余学勤表示，香港金管局与证监会去年共同制定固定收益及货币市场发展路线图，当中很多细节经港交所落实。他在财资市场高峰会上透露，预计明年初将推出以人民币计价、在香港交收的黄金期货合约，并陆续推出更多以人民币计价贵金属等商品的投资产品，以丰富人民币计价资产选择。
text_en: [HKEX: More RMB-denominated commodity investment products such as precious metals will be launched successively] Wilfred Yiu, managing director and head of markets at HKEX, said that the Hong Kong Monetary Authority and the Securities and Futures Commission jointly formulated a roadmap for the development of the fixed income and currency markets last year, and many details of it have been implemented by HKEX. Speaking at the Treasury Markets Summit, he revealed that gold futures contracts denominated in RMB and settled in Hong Kong are expected to be launched early next year, and more investment products in commodities such as precious metals denominated in RMB will be launched successively to enrich RMB-denominated asset options.
